description: Create a human approval request (Approval Relay). Show approveUrl / approve_url to your human, then poll approval_status. Served by Approval Relay at relay.moneytools.dev (0.005 USDC, 3 free/day; signed Ed25519 receipt). Old field names (title, approveUrl, id, agentToken, proof) are still accepted and returned as aliases. approve.moneytools.dev stays available for existing HTTP/MCP callers.

callback_url.description: Optional https callback that receives the signed receipt

details.description: Optional extra context folded into action_summary

notify.description: Legacy; notify.webhook is used as callback_url if set

requester.description: Optional label shown to the approver

risk.description: Risk level shown to the approver (default med)

name: approval_request
title: Ask your human to approve a payment
